LaneSlice.description:
A slice of a chop or of a source, played as a drum lane's sound (WP17).

Exactly one of ``chop`` (a slice of that chop: ``start_beats`` counts beats
into the chop, its stem and warp are the chop's) or ``source`` (with
``start_downbeat``; ``start_beats`` counts beats along the source's grid
from that downbeat, like a chop's ``start_offset_beats``; ``stem`` and
``warp`` belong to this form only).

``speed``: ``project`` = warped to the project tempo exactly like a chop of
that length (the chop warp path: it fills ``length_beats`` project beats);
``source`` = the record's own speed and pitch (no warp, its natural length).

stem.description: Source slices only (default mix); chop slices use the chop's.
stem.title: Stem

warp.description: Source slices only (default resample); chops use their own.

LaneSlice.title: LaneSlice

Warp.description:
How source audio conforms to the project tempo.

* ``resample``: the playback rate is set by tempo ONLY,
  ``project_bpm / source_local_bpm``, so the chop always fills its
  grid slot exactly; the tempo-induced pitch change IS the vinyl
  effect. A single rate is used for the whole chop.
* ``stretch``: pitch-preserving time-stretch to the grid (Rubber
  Band; each source beat is mapped onto the project grid, beat-wise).

In both modes ``pitch_semitones`` is an additional LENGTH-PRESERVING
pitch shift (high-quality shifter), applied after the warp — it never
changes the chop's grid span.

formants.description: Preserve formants when pitch_semitones != 0. Default: on for stem: vocals only (measured: it colours instruments and drums).
formants.title: Formants
